result.response:
The money-transfer review flow for case `l04` has been implemented according to the product request, fixture, and frozen TasteForge workflow.

### Implementation Summary
- **Primary Task & Visible Fees**: Implemented the entry form with pre-filled fixture data (Alex Morgan sending to Nguyễn Thị Minh Anh Trường, initially $250.00 USD) and an immediate breakdown showing the flat $2.50 USD fee, total debited ($252.50 USD), exchange rate (25,000 VND/USD), recipient amount (6,250,000 VND), and delivery estimate before commitment.
- **Review & Recalculation**: Provided review screen showing recipient, sent amount, fee, total debited, amount received, and delivery estimate. The "Edit details" action ([`data-testid="edit-transfer"`](file:///C:/Users/hi/src/personal_repos/TasteForge/evals/runs/2026-11-02-lean-workflow-probe/cases/l04/index.html#L210-L213)) retains both inputs, allows changing amounts (validating $1.00–$1,000.00 range without input loss), and recalculates values on return.
- **Simulated Error & Recovery**: The first confirmation attempt returns a recoverable simulated network error with clear feedback on [`data-testid="transfer-status"`](file:///C:/Users/hi/src/personal_repos/TasteForge/evals/runs/2026-11-02-lean-workflow-probe/cases/l04/index.html#L149-L157) and reveals [`data-testid="retry-transfer"`](file:///C:/Users/hi/src/personal_repos/TasteForge/evals/runs/2026-11-02-lean-workflow-probe/cases/l04/index.html#L217-L220). Retrying succeeds and displays the completed simulated status.
- **Diacritics & Responsive Access**: Proper UTF-8 diacritic support for long Vietnamese names, clean text-wrapping, and responsive flex/card layouts passing geometry checks at 320px, 390px, and 1440px.
- **Inspection & Focused Correction**:
  - Initial preview (`preview.mjs`) showed `.card { display: flex; }` overriding `[hidden]` on initial render, and an entity issue in the recipient name.
  - Applied one focused correction adding `[hidden] { display: none !important; }` in [styles.css](file:///C:/Users/hi/src/personal_repos/TasteForge/evals/runs/2026-11-02-lean-workflow-probe/cases/l04/styles.css#L44-L46) and canonical UTF-8 in [index.html](file:///C:/Users/hi/src/personal_repos/TasteForge/evals/runs/2026-11-02-lean-workflow-probe/cases/l04/index.html).
  - Executed the permitted post-correction recheck (`recheck.mjs`) and verified the rendered viewports at 320px, 390px, and 1440px.
- Documentation saved in [implementation-notes.md](file:///C:/Users/hi/src/personal_repos/TasteForge/evals/runs/2026-11-02-lean-workflow-probe/cases/l04/implementation-notes.md).
